title: A simple model for one-dimensional nonlinear thermoelasticity: Well-posedness in rough-data frameworks
summary: In an open bounded interval $Ω$, the problem \[ u_{tt} = u_{xx} - \big(f(Θ)\big)_x, Θ_t = Θ_{xx} - f(Θ) u_{xt}, \] is considered under the boundary conditions $u|_{\partialΩ}=Θ_x|_{\partialΩ}=0$, and for $f\in C^2([0,\infty))$ satisfying $f(0)=0$, $f'>0$ on $[0,\infty)$ and $f'\in W^{1,\infty}((0,\infty))$. In the sense of unconditional global existence, uniqueness and continuous dependence, this problem is shown to be well-posed within ranges of initial data merely satisfying \[ u_0\in W_0^{1,2}(Ω), \quad u_{0t} \in L^2(Ω) \quad \mbox{and} \quad Θ_0 \in L^2(Ω) \mbox{ with $Θ\ge 0$ a.e.~in…
